questions.question: In a psalm asking God to be gracious and bless His people, what reason is given for the blessing?

answers.text: So His ways are known on earth
So their land is safe from war
So they can rest from hard work

questions.question: In a psalm that repeats the line "Let the peoples praise You, O God," who is called on to praise God?
In a psalm of praise, the nations sing for joy because of how God judges the peoples. How does He judge them?
In a psalm about God's blessing, God blesses His people so that who will fear Him?

answers.text: All the ends of the earth
